original: Meals When moving into a student dormitory or student apartment, you may be able to choose a plan that includes meals.
zh: 入住學生宿舍或學生公寓時，可能可以選擇含餐方案。

original: Rent in central Tokyo is high, so many students commute from outside the city.
zh: 東京市中心租金較高，因此許多學生從市區以外通勤。

original: All necessary furniture and appliances are provided, and meals are often included.
zh: 提供必要家具與家電，通常也包含餐食。

original: Location Check how long it takes to get to each Meiji University campus and how you will commute by train.
zh: 選擇住宿地點時，請確認前往明治大學各校區的時間與鐵路通勤方式。

original: Here, Teaching Assistants (TA) offer Japanese language study support for international students.
zh: 此處由教學助理（TA）為國際學生提供日語學習支援。

original: The International Lounge is open for international students, exchange students and also students wishing to study abroad or make friends from other countries.
zh: 國際交流空間開放給國際學生、交換生，以及有意出國或認識其他國家朋友的學生。

original: Meiji University strives to create an academic environment that promotes diversity, acceptance and unity.
zh: 明治大學致力於建立鼓勵多元、接納與團結的學術環境。

original: USP strongly recommends that students take part in the USP iFriends programme in order for them to get assistance with finding accommodation.
zh: USP 建議交換生參加 USP iFriends 計畫，以獲得尋找住宿的協助。

original: All exchange students have access to the university restaurants. Several campuses offer free bus transportation. Please check the relevant website (available in Portuguese).
zh: 所有交換生都可使用大學餐廳。部分校區提供免費公車；請查閱相關葡萄牙文網站。

original: Please note that starting from the 2027-2 semester, the accommodation fees will be subject to an adjustment. The updated values will be informed shortly.
zh: 原頁提醒：自 2027-2 學期起，住宿費將調整，新金額尚待公布。

original: The monthly rent with breakfast included will be R$2.500,00 per month (If a meal option is available (lunch or dinner), the cost per month will be R$2.875,00 per month for the 2026/2027-1 semester .
zh: 原頁列示 2026/2027-1 學期寄宿家庭費用：含早餐每月 R$2,500；若可加選午餐或晚餐，每月 R$2,875。

original: All students have to pay for their accommodation and living expenses as well as their books and other study materials. The total monthly living expenses of a single student average from 900 to 1 250 euros, depending on your spending habits. Accommodation is a big part of this, e.g. one month's rent in student housing is normally 450-800 euros.
zh: 學生須自行支付住宿、生活、書籍與學習材料費用。原頁估計單身學生每月生活費約 €900–1,250，依消費習慣而異；其中學生住宿月租通常約 €450–800。

original: Meals, cafe, refreshments and bakery goods at affordable prices are served in the UniCafe restaurants on campus. Student lunch prices and contact information for the cafeterias can be found on the UniCafe website . Lunch prices for students vary between 2,95 - 5,55 €. Exchange students do not need Student Union membership to receive the lunch discount at UniCafe.
zh: 校內 UniCafe 提供餐點、咖啡、飲料與烘焙食品。原頁列示學生午餐約 €2.95–5.55；交換生不需加入學生會，也可使用 UniCafe 午餐優惠。

original: As an exchange student, you are entitled to discounted fares in public transport in the Helsinki metropolitan area (operated by HSL) as well as in long-distance transport. The discount is only for undergraduate students (Bachelor & Master's). Exchange students do not need Student Union membership to receive the HSL discount.
zh: 原頁說明交換生可使用赫爾辛基都會區 HSL 及長途交通學生優惠，適用學士與碩士學生；使用 HSL 優惠不需加入學生會。

original: * Due to the limited number of units available at these residences, most KyotoU international students reside in non-university housing, such as in privately managed apartments.
zh: 由於學校住宿名額有限，多數京都大學國際學生住在校外，例如私人出租公寓。

original: Japanese law stipulates that all students studying at Japanese universities for more than three months must enroll in the country's National Health Insurance (NHI) program, which costs around 2,000 yen per month.
zh: 原頁說明，在日本大學就讀超過三個月的學生須加入日本國民健康保險，參考費用約每月 ¥2,000。

original: When entering Kyoto University, students must also join the University CO-OP Personal Liability Insurance for Students (Gakubai), which requires an annual payment of around 2,000 yen. To enroll in Gakubai, students must first join the CO-OP by paying a 4,000-yen membership fee, which is fully refundable upon deregistration.
zh: 入學時另須加入學生個人賠償責任保險 Gakubai，參考年費約 ¥2,000；加入前須先加入大學生協，繳納 ¥4,000 會費，退會時可全額退還。
